topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Well, ain't this a twist of the reaper's scythe? Gideon’s as good as a brother to me, been by my side through dung and drought. Now he’s set to leave for parts unknown, where the earth is as strange to him as the moon. I can’t fathom what the world holds for him, out there beyond the hills where the sky stretches wide and the air tastes of storm. Tending this soil, I never thought to venture far, and now the thought of my best from birth leaving the village, it’s like a frost has settled on the seed of our friendship. These walls, these paths, they’ve seen us through all our seasons. What will I say at the well when his voice is just a memory carried by the wind? The seasons turn, and we with them, but some turns are hard, harder than the ground after a long winter.
